title: The Locked Counter
verdict: Noah Frost was responsible for the disappearance of a glaze formula card.
intent: Noah Frost wanted to copy a signature glaze before the exhibition.
The culprit needed delayed discovery so the object could pass the first search and be recovered later.
action_schema: Use role-specific access: the senior potter entered the kiln room during the pause to check firing samples.
Remove a glaze formula card from its checked location.
Hide the item in a clay reclaim bucket beneath the wedging table.
Allow incomplete suspicion to fall on distractor suspects.

The object was confirmed present before the relevant disturbance.

The relevant tool or mechanism was a kiln glove with blue glaze dust.
The item could be concealed in a clay reclaim bucket beneath the wedging table.
